# CrossLinguisticSemanticTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A conceptual network topology where nodes are language-specific idioms and edges encode cross-linguistic semantic similarity based on feature overlap. Demonstrates how semantic relationships can be modeled as physical network topologies, informing TCC design for multilingual cognitive workloads.
